glosses: A person who recites literary works, usually to an audience.

examples.text: They were dog-eared by the hands of many a publisher's-reader and postman.

glosses: A position attached to aristocracy, or to the wealthy, with the task of reading aloud, often in a foreign language.

examples.text: "I am commissioned by the Queen to offer you the place of Italian reader; and I assure you the offer was made with many kind expressions of interest. You will enter upon the duties, which are almost nominal, immediately."

examples.text: The percussion primer, known as the “ 110-grain percussion primer,” contains an igniting charge of 95 grains of black powder in addition to the essential elements of a percussion primer.
